_comment: Metadata types the agent may create or modify. Anything not listed is refused by guard-metadata.sh, in the local build step and again in CI. The denied list is documentation only: it is not consulted by code, because the allowlist already excludes it. It exists so a reader can see what was deliberately left out and why.

denied.Profile: Org-wide access changes. A human makes these in Setup with a change record.
denied.PermissionSetGroup: Compound access; review one permission set at a time instead.
denied.ApexClass: Code needs tests and a code reviewer. Out of scope for v1 of this agent.
denied.ApexTrigger: Same as ApexClass, with order-of-execution risk.
denied.LightningComponentBundle: UI code; out of scope for v1.
denied.AuraDefinitionBundle: UI code; out of scope for v1.
denied.StandardValueSet: Changes standard picklists (Opportunity stages, Lead status) that reports and automation depend on org-wide.
denied.Settings: Org settings are never changed by automation.
denied.destructiveChanges: Nothing is ever deleted by this pipeline. Deletions are a separate, human-run procedure.
